title: Bilkis Bano case
narrative: FIR — Bilkis Bano case, Randhikpur, Dahod district, Gujarat. On 3 March 2002, during the Gujarat riots, Bilkis Bano, then 21 years old and five months pregnant, was gang-raped by a mob armed with swords and sticks, which also killed 14 members of her family, including her three-year-old daughter Saleha. Eleven men were convicted of the gang rape and murders and sentenced to life imprisonment in January 2008 by a special court; the trial had been transferred to Maharashtra. The convicts were controversially released in 2022 and ordered back to prison by the Supreme Court in January 2024.
